description:
Problem: cli.py gateway-clients writes clients.json with exactly one client, oracle-ci (_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/cli.py:43, :891-915). Local pre-PR reviews and cloud builders need their own gateway clients so each token can be rotated or revoked without breaking CI reviews (owner decision 2026-10-25: a second gateway client, oracle-local, rather than reusing oracle-ci's token or local provider settings).

Outcome: gateway-clients accepts additional named clients, each with its own token file, and writes one entry per client with its own tokenSha256 and identical models and accounts lists. Invoked with only oracle-ci it writes exactly what it writes today. Host apply on the gateway Mac (authorized by the owner 2026-10-25): create ~/.omp/oracle-gateway/local-client.token (mode 0600, at least 32 random bytes, never printed), back up clients.json, regenerate it with oracle-ci and oracle-local through the documented host procedure (docs/internal/oracle-gateway-host.md), and let the gateway re-read it (it reloads every 10 seconds; no restart).

Decision gates:
1. Before editing, confirm that omp auth-gateway serve --clients accepts several named entries (omp 18.12.6 source or docs, or the running gateway's behaviour with a test file outside the live path). If it does not, stop and ask; do not upgrade or reconfigure the gateway.
2. Host apply happens only after the PR merges, from develop's code.

Item guardrails: never print, log or commit a token value; never read, use or copy the gateway admin token; do not rotate or change oracle-ci's token or entry; do not restart or upgrade the gateway; keep clients.json and token files at mode 0600; keep the backup until the live checks pass, and restore it on any failure.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, comments) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Run make docs-reference-inventory-check and make doc-contracts-guard in addition to make pr-preflight. Close out with make pr-open, oracle SHIP on the exact head, make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge, never a stand-in or bypass on these oracle soundness paths.
